summary_bullets: Add default-off aggregate-findings input containment opt-in with early boolean validation and split-argv parsing
Keep symlink and post-dispatch output containment strict while making outside-input mv failures non-fatal
Document the trust boundary and cover outside-input rejection, opt-in success, invalid flag ordering, and output-containment regression cases
commit_message:
Relax aggregate findings input containment behind opt-in

Add --allow-findings-outside-tmpdir as a default-off split-argv flag for aggregate-findings.sh. The flag is validated before filesystem containment checks, relaxes only the input findings-file containment rejection, and preserves strict symlink and output-candidate containment. Guard outside-input replacement failures so they report dispatch-failed without clobbering the original ballot.

Document the asymmetric trust boundary in aggregate-findings.md and SECURITY.md, and extend the aggregate-findings harness with outside-input rejection, invalid flag ordering, opt-in merge success, and strict output-containment coverage.
